diagnostics.message: The graph gives :resource.null_resource.file_permission no dependency on :resource.local_file.private_ssh_key, so chmod can run before the file exists. The source contains this depends_on already; ensure it is preserved in the effective graph, or reference the file's filename in the command.

module.runner:resource.aws_autoscaling_group.gitlab_runner_instance can boot the runner before module.runner:resource.aws_iam_role_policy_attachment.ssm grants the SSM permissions used by registration user data. Order instance startup after this attachment when token management is enabled.

module.runner2:resource.aws_autoscaling_group.gitlab_runner_instance can boot the runner before module.runner2:resource.aws_iam_role_policy_attachment.ssm grants the SSM permissions used by registration user data. Order instance startup after this attachment when token management is enabled.

module.runner:resource.aws_autoscaling_group.gitlab_runner_instance should wait for module.runner:resource.aws_ssm_parameter.runner_registration_token: its user-data manages this parameter's value, while Terraform initially writes "null". Concurrent creation can fail or overwrite the registered token.

module.runner2:resource.aws_autoscaling_group.gitlab_runner_instance should wait for module.runner2:resource.aws_ssm_parameter.runner_registration_token: its user-data manages this parameter's value, while Terraform initially writes "null". Concurrent creation can fail or overwrite the registered token.

module.runner:resource.aws_autoscaling_group.gitlab_runner_instance starts the docker+machine runner but does not wait for module.runner:resource.aws_iam_role_policy_attachment.instance_docker_machine_policy. The instance-profile reference only waits for the role, not its EC2 provisioning permissions; early jobs can fail.

module.runner2:resource.aws_autoscaling_group.gitlab_runner_instance starts the docker+machine runner but does not wait for module.runner2:resource.aws_iam_role_policy_attachment.instance_docker_machine_policy. The instance-profile reference only waits for the role, not its EC2 provisioning permissions; early jobs can fail.
